meta.noteEn: Original practice questions written for this site and organised by the AET PCP course's 25 online modules. They are not AET's own quiz items. Where the course teaches BCEHS practice that differs from the EMALB examination guidelines, the explanation tells you which answer the licensing exam expects.
meta.noteZh: 本站原创练习题，按 AET PCP 课程的 25 门线上模块编排，不是学校原题。课上讲的 BCEHS 实际做法和 EMALB 考纲不一致时，解析会告诉你执照考试要的是哪个答案。
